section.p: Consider a "Configure Authentication Method" chapter in a "Security Administration Guide" document where users can choose one of several valid authentication configuration methods.
section.codeblock:
Configure an authentication method for user sign-in.

The platform supports multiple authentication providers.

Open the Authentication Settings page. Select the authentication method to configure. Configure local authentication using internal user accounts. Configure SAML single sign-on (SSO) integration. Configure OAuth 2.0 authentication using an external identity provider.

The selected authentication configuration page opens.

Users can authenticate using the configured authentication provider.
section.p: Result: Users know they must select one option from multiple valid procedural alternatives within the same step.
